findings.description: BeautifulSoup HTML parser initialization in html5lib builder - not XML parsing
findings.reasoning: This code initializes a BeautifulSoup object with the 'html.parser' parser (HTML parsing, not XML). The CodeQL query flagged it as potentially vulnerable to XXE, but this is HTML parsing, not XML parsing. XXE vulnerabilities specifically affect XML parsers when they process external entity references. HTML parsers don't process XML entities in the same way, making this a false positive.
